blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Phoenix coach Charles Tiu liked what he saw from Marcellus Earlington in a winning debut against Meralco in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup after pondering tapping two players who would go on to play in the ongoing conference. Earlington had 20 points, 14 rebounds and five assists as the Fuel Masters came back to beat the Bolts, 105-101, on Friday at Ynares Center in Antipolo, which assured them a place in the quarterfinals.
